# secopsctl

> Operate Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM + Siemplify SOAR) as code — one Go CLI and one importable Go SDK. The core loop is pull live state → review the git diff → push it back.

## Docs

- [Home](https://secops.danny.vn): Overview, quick start, and navigation
- [Install](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/install): Build from source or download signed release binaries
- [Configure & auth](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/configure): Config file, SIEM ADC, SOAR AppKey setup
- [The loop](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/the-loop): The pull → git diff → push workflow
- [Rules](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/rules): YARA-L detection rules management
- [Search](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/search): UDM, raw log, stats, and event search
- [Gemini](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/gemini): Natural-language search and AI assistant
- [SOAR cases](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/soar-cases): Case lifecycle and triage
- [Triage](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/triage): Alert and case triage workflows
- [Playbooks](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/playbooks): Playbook authoring and management
- [Content Hub](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/content-hub): Marketplace integrations and content packs
- [Reconcile surfaces](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/reconcile): Config-as-code reconciliation engine
- [Go SDK](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/sdk): Importable Go clients for SIEM and SOAR

## Reference

- [SIEM reference](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/reference-siem): All SIEM commands and flags
- [SOAR reference](https://secops.danny.vn/#/guides/reference-soar): All SOAR commands and flags
- [Architecture](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/architecture): Internal design and module layout
- [API surfaces](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/surfaces): Every API family by plane, host, and auth
- [Catalog](https://secops.danny.vn/#/design/catalog): Live status of every surface and command

- [Dashboards](https://secops.danny.vn/#/tips/06-dashboards): Dashboard design and management
- [UDM queries](https://secops.danny.vn/#/tips/07-udm-queries): Query language and patterns
- [Feeds & parsers](https://secops.danny.vn/#/tips/08-feeds-parsers): Log ingestion pipeline

- [Parser extensions](https://secops.danny.vn/#/tips/12-parser-extensions): Custom parser development
